nodes.title: Publish thread
nodes.description: Publish a Threads post: TEXT, IMAGE, VIDEO or CAROUSEL (2-20 items) from public media URLs, optionally as a reply or quote, with a poll, link, topic tag or reply controls. Waits for Threads to process the media (up to 6 minutes). If publishing fails after the container was made, retry with `container_id` instead of re-running, so nothing is posted twice.

text.description: Post text, at most 500 characters (required for TEXT)

carousel_items.description: CAROUSEL: 2-20 items, each {image_url} or {video_url}, optional alt_text

reply_to_id.description: Publish as a reply to this media id

link_attachment.description: URL shown as a link preview (TEXT posts)

container_id.description: Publish this existing container (from a failed attempt) instead of creating a new one

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
